result.instructions: Tools for Infoplus, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find active items and their reorder metadata."; "Show inventory quantities by SKU and warehouse location."; "Check an order's status and shipped quantities.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Infoplus data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run infoplus_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run infoplus_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run infoplus_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. infoplus_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: infoplus_search_warehouses
tools.title: Search Infoplus warehouses
tools.description: Read one page of warehouse logistics metadata. Optional Infoplus filter and sort expressions. A full_page result may have a following page; request the next page to check. Reads only; no automatic pagination or retries. Pace calls within the API user's 3/second and site-wide 10/second limits.

filter.description: Infoplus filter expression, for example status eq "On Order" for orders. Use fields from the resource's API reference.

sort.description: Infoplus sort expression using a documented resource field.

tools.name: infoplus_get_warehouse
tools.title: Read an Infoplus warehouse
tools.description: Read selected warehouse logistics metadata by its Infoplus numeric record ID. Does not modify, allocate, receive or ship stock.

record_id.description: Infoplus numeric record ID from a search result, as a string.
